C1370.title: Cross-Chain Bridge Attacks Cause Over $2 Billion in Historical Losses
C1370.summary: According to PANews statistics, cross-chain bridge security incidents have occurred frequently, with historical losses exceeding $2 billion. 2022 was the year with the most frequent bridge exploits. Recently, well-known bridges like Poly Network and Multichain have again experienced thefts or abnormal fund transfers, and the probability of fund recovery or compensation is declining.
